q: Waves are classified as transverse and longitudinal waves depending on ____ of particles in the medium through which they propagate.
e: The classification of waves is based on the direction of particle vibration relative to the direction of wave propagation.

q: If the displacements of particles of the medium are ____ to the direction of the wave, such a wave is called a transverse wave.
e: In transverse waves, particle motion is at right angles to the direction the wave travels.

q: Waves in a vibrating string are ____.
e: The particles of a vibrating string move up and down while the wave travels horizontally, making them transverse.

q: Light waves and other electromagnetic waves are also ____.
e: Electromagnetic waves oscillate perpendicular to their direction of travel, classifying them as transverse.

q: If the displacements of particles of medium are ____ to the direction of the waves, such a wave is called a longitudinal wave.
e: In longitudinal waves, particle motion occurs in the same direction as the wave propagation.

q: Compressional waves in a slinky coiled spring and sound waves are ____.
e: These waves propagate through alternating regions of compression and rarefaction parallel to the direction of travel.
